speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. You mention a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling on your palms; to begin my assessment, how long have these symptoms been present, and do you have any known autoimmune conditions or recent viral infections?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lichen Planus is unlikely given the sensory symptoms; the combination of a pruritic rash and bilateral sensory neuropathy (numbness/tingling) in a patient with rice farming and livestock exposure strongly suggests a toxic reaction, most likely to organophosphates (pesticides) or arsenic, leading to a diagnosis of Arsenic Poisoning or Organophosphate Toxicity manifesting with a dermatitis and peripheral neuropathy.
